proposal.title: Removing the 'District' demarcation on all Maps
proposal.author: 0x8218…0d59
proposal.description:
Districts are mostly, if not all defunct. In the past 3 years, we've seen Dragon City,Vegas City, DCL Uni and Aetheria either return LANDs to their contributors, or sell them away.

I petition to remove the purple "fog of war" so that everyone who owns LAND in said areas can see where our LAND/ESTATEs are located side by !

rationales.name: 0xA5F9…fE32
rationales.text: District boundaries are no longer accurate on the map. I'd be in favor of a toggle to reveal the LAND or faster map updates.
